cells.normalized_text: On Precision Kill: Target explodes, dealing up to 104 [80] Solar Damage in a 7.5 metre radius, and grants +50 +55 Reload Speed for 6 seconds. Reload Buff persists through stow. Damage against Combatants scales differently by Weapon Type and Combatant Rank :)

sources.format_evidence: Original +55 reload value uses #ffd966 enhanced formatting. Snapshot flattening had removed this distinction.

sources.finding: Firefly 与其他击杀爆炸改用统一 perk 缩放；不沿用旧武器原型对战斗人员倍率。
Ace of Spades 专属 Firefly 的PvE最大伤害65到100、最小0到20，范围6到7.5米，衰减起点从半径30%到50%。此前研究核对补丁，本轮正文检索失败，以下官方前瞻正文直接复核相同值。
Ace of Spades段明确专属Firefly的100/20、7.5米与50%起点。最小/最大比0.2为推导；不能把此配置强加到所有传奇Firefly。
436 PvE、80 PvP、7.5米范围、3.75米开始衰减；+50装填属性6秒。与原表及强化页面数值冲突，保持独立输入。
强化条目给104/80、4米范围、+55装填属性6秒，并明确比普通多5点。研究未标更新时间；不从条目版本修改日期推断数值实测日期。

implementation.qualification: Same owner and weapon; confirmed weapon_kill plus physical precision classification. Incoming element is irrelevant to fixed Solar output.
implementation.reload: Independent reward rule; +50/+55 stat points for six seconds, reset refresh, keep on stow, per-weapon scope, remove on source detach. Invalid explosion geometry does not discard a qualified reload reward.
implementation.explosion: Capture fixed weapon_damage/explosive_perk_damage/firefly_damage/solar_damage and weapon_kill credit; no precision inheritance, no global proc block. Normal and enhanced have identical configured base damage.
implementation.falloff: Required external normalized curve f and mode-specific minimum m: full plateau=1, interior=m+(1-m)*f, outer edge=m, outside=no target. Validate f and m in [0,1]. Synthetic tests use linear f; explicit100/104/436 inputs remain distinct.
implementation.timing: Historical feet center, capture source bonus at kill, explicit zero or detached positive delay, live enemy selection. Source removal before kill disables proc; removal after capture removes reload buff but preserves pending blast.
implementation.reload_calibration: Shared weapon_reload -> synthetic rifle time (2-0.01*stat) -> reload_animation pipeline. Base10 gives1.9s, normal60 gives1.4s, enhanced65 gives1.35s. Accepted reload duration survives buff expiry.
implementation.world_units: Synthetic 0.1 damage scale, body/head10/15, finite5-round magazines and12 reserves; contact weakpoint and projectile parameters are test inputs.

remaining: 原表104/80、强化公开索引104/80及4米、普通公开索引436/80及7.5米存在版本 / 基准差异；原表未给平台，3.75米平台仅作为显式研究输入。当前未独立校准完整统一perk、敌人等级 / 活动 / 异域缩放。
官方黑桃 A 的100最大 / 20最小仅用于证明非零下限表达；未完整实现黑桃 A、Memento Mori、催化剂及其他武器特例。普通Firefly的最小伤害和真实内部距离曲线未确定。
六秒刷新、收枪后晚到击杀、卸装清理、同武器隔离、确认击杀时取样及已接受换弹保持时长是当前内容政策，需原作边界与组合验收。
线性内部衰减、0/0.1秒延迟、0.1世界伤害映射、基础装填10与2-0.01×stat秒曲线、武器弹量 / 弹道 / 弱点均为合成校准；实际动画和HUD尚未接入。
正式内容目录 / 子职业装配、完整死亡 / 离线政策、所有伤害资格与护盾特例、实体投射物跨重启仍未完成。纯会话检查点不等于全世界持久化。
